questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the reversible field-free diode? Your p. 4 and Extended Data Fig. 4 show two bars, one along [010] and one along [100]; were there others, on this chip or other chips, and over how many cooldowns?
Why were the others set aside?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: preparation fields along [100] beyond ±1 T (Fig. 3d stops there while Fig. 3e goes to ±4 T), temperatures above 20 mK, and small applied fields near zero, in plane and out of plane?

What does the second-best device or dataset look like, for example the [100] bar's zero-field-cooled efficiency and its switching-current distributions, and the sign of the 7% zero-field-cooled efficiency in other cooldowns?
After you prepare one remanent state, if you warm the bar above the Al transition at H = 0 and cool again, does η keep its sign and size?

What is the residual field of your magnet at the sample after the ±1 T and ±4 T excursions, and how did you calibrate it? Does η versus a small out-of-plane field near zero shift between the two prepared states?
Were both bars on the same chip and mounting, so that the [100] crystal axis sat along the same magnet axis for both? Have you rotated the chip by 90° relative to the magnet and repeated Fig. 3d,e?
Can you read the Néel state on the superconducting wafer itself, for example R_even on the bar above the Al transition, so that the Fig. 4 comparison comes from the same film and device as Fig. 3?
